{{Quote|What's your pleasure?''"<br />"''A shot of your finest!|The Anacondan and Rako Hardeen|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] '''bartender''' worked in [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. He had no arms and legs, instead using his tail to distribute drinks to patrons, hanging from a rack over the cantina counter. He was responsible for giving [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] his drink, and later informing [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] that Hardeen was in a backroom.

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified character first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also portrays [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the series.
